data.name: Hafiza
data.gender_notes: Hafiza is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of ḥāfiẓ, from the Arabic root ح-ف-ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ), 'to guard, memorise'. Its root is ح-ف-ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ). A common Muslim female name. Hafiza is a Arabic name meaning “Guardian (female); one who memorises”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hafiza expresses “Guardian (female); one who memorises”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of ḥāfiẓ, from the Arabic root ح-ف-ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ), 'to guard, memorise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hafiza total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
